scope: Independent cross-review of the complete revised motion exposition and changed outlines, all 12 numbered contracts, and actual public Lean types/proof interfaces. Not a replay or line-by-line audit of all compiler internals.
checks: Ambient-open regions and full-level crossing convention match the definitions.
Countable labeling uses finite initial subfamilies, then continuity of finite measure; no finite subcover assumed.
Nonuniform state bits, high-entropy inputs, representative selection, and all uniform subsequential limits agree with native endpoints.
Physical scaling and universal/further-subsequence pointwise approximation quantifiers preserved.
All three palette bounds retain exact declared operations, eventual correctness and public size dependence.
Clock ownership covers all actual ticks; a node and its descendants need not form a contiguous interval.
Stage regularity uses global ticks and positive duration/diverging volume; the frozen tail is included.
Exceptional time and per-node corollary agree with formal budget inequalities, including derived k>0.

items.label: def:motion-star
items.program_role: Fixes the exact inherited crossing condition used by the motion impossibility argument.

items.label: thm:motion-affine-time
items.program_role: Gives the quantitative exceptional-time obstruction used by all subsequent native motion exclusions.

items.label: thm:motion-native-limits
items.program_role: Derives relevant representatives and physical-time obstruction from native correctness, including nonuniform/high-entropy families.

items.label: def:motion-affine-cover
items.program_role: Specifies the finite-piece approximation interface for candidate execution paths.

items.label: lem:motion-cover-closure
items.program_role: Transfers pointwise bounded-cover approximation to locally affine limits, enabling the native contradiction.

items.label: thm:motion-pointwise
items.program_role: Rules out native fast transposers with the stated universal/further-subsequence approximation property.

items.label: thm:motion-palettes
items.program_role: Excludes bounded words in the three implemented palettes with no extra caller-supplied geometry premise.

items.label: def:motion-clock
items.program_role: Charges every actual tick to a contracting recursion stage; does not assume free recursion.

items.label: lem:motion-clock-accounting
items.program_role: Provides the time bound and depth/exceptional-work estimates used in the recursive limit argument.

items.label: def:motion-stage-regularity
items.program_role: States the exact actual-stage limit obligation a recursive candidate must meet before the obstruction applies.

items.label: thm:motion-exceptional-recursion
items.program_role: Quantifies the positive exceptional-time budget and excludes all-regular contracting stage families.

items.label: cor:motion-node-exception
items.program_role: Converts per-node exceptional-work allowances into a necessary global coefficient bound.
